title: Executive Data Export
scenario: A leader asks for all employee salary data in a spreadsheet by email.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.C: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: Executive Data Export: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Sensitive exports require approved channel and business justification.
